name: Being Different
overview: Scripture teaches that being different is rooted in our creation in God's image, setting humanity apart by design (Genesis 1:27). Believers are called to reject the counsel and paths of the ungodly, choosing instead the narrow way that leads to life (Psalms 1:1; Proverbs 1:15; Matthew 7:13). This distinctiveness is not merely external but involves a transformation of the mind through renewal, enabling Christians to discern and live according to God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). From before birth, God has a unique purpose for each person, underscoring the sacred calling to stand apart and live consecrated lives (Jeremiah 1:5).
